description: Return current physical-world evidence and historical forecast reliability for a coordinate. Every available value keeps its provenance, distance, age, measured/predicted status and confidence; source divergence is reported. Nearby station wind readings are cross-checked; possible sensor/reporting anomalies are flagged for review, not diagnosed as confirmed failures. For drones, separate model-derived precipitation and thunderstorm context is provided when available; the outcome includes wind and model precipitation and thunderstorm indications and is not lightning detection. Required but unavailable evidence is named, never silently estimated.

domain.description: Operational domain; defaults to general. Legacy domain argument remains supported.

field.description: Alias for domain; when both are supplied they must agree.

time.description: Optional ISO 8601 time. This release supports current conditions only (within 10 minutes of now).

name: sense_location
